articles.summary: Twenty One Capital, Inc. (“Twenty One” or “XXI”) (NYSE: XXI), today announced that Management is participating in the following October conferences. Maxim Growth Summit 2026 Dates: October 12–14, 2026 Location: Hard Rock Hotel, New York, NY Attendee: Steven Meehan, Chief Financial Officer Website: https://maximgrp.com/2026-growth-summit Bitfinex: The Future of Capital Markets Date: October 22, 2026 Location: LAC Lugano Arte e Cultura, Lugano, Switzerland Speaker: Raphael Zagury, Chief Executive Officer Website: https://thefutureofcapitalmarkets.com Plan B Forum 2026 Dates: October 23–24, 2026 Location: Palazzo dei Congressi, Lugano, Switzerland Speakers: Raphael Zagury, Chief Executive Officer Nico Moran, Head of Communications Website: https://planb.lugano.ch/planb-forum To schedule a one-on-one meeting with Twenty One’s management team during these conferences please email KCSA Strategic Communications at XXI@KCSA.com .
